Subtitle: Organic Concentrated Amendment
Brief Overview: A potent, concentrated organic amendment packed with macro and micronutrients, microbial biology, and structural elements. SuperBooster is too hot to use alone, but mixed into existing soil, it supercharges plant growth for fruits, vegetables, and specialty crops.
Key Features/benefits: Highly concentrated organic nutrition, rich microbial diversity, balanced macro and micronutrients.
Target audience: Fruit Growers, Vegetable Cultivators, Commercial Farms, Nurseries, Home Gardeners
Recommended Uses: Soil amendment for fruit trees, vegetable beds, specialty crops. Not a standalone potting soil.
Gardener Usage Instructions: Mix 1 part SuperBooster with 4 parts existing soil for new plantings or garden beds. For established plants, topdress with a 1/2 inch layer and work into the soil surface.

Subtitle: Concentrated Amendment for Roses
Brief Overview: A premium concentrated blend crafted specifically for roses. Combines organic matter, micronutrients, and mycorrhizal fungi to promote vibrant blooms, strong stems, and robust root systems.
Key Features/benefits: Rose-specific micronutrient package, promotes vibrant blooms, includes mycorrhizal fungi for root health.
Target audience: Rose Gardeners, Nurseries, Landscapers, Home Gardeners, Estate Gardens
Recommended Uses: Rose bed amendment, rose planting mix, monthly rose topdressing
Gardener Usage Instructions: Each month, topdress roses with 1 cup of Cultivator's Rose Blend. Gently blend into the top 1/2 inch of soil, then water thoroughly.
